controls.name: Portable regression lane
controls.scope: Controller, HTTP adapter, setup and spectator regressions. Includes gameplay record validation and bounded evidence retention using synthetic observations.
controls.mechanism: Common command compiles Python, runs selected Ruff correctness diagnostics, Import Linter contracts, JavaScript syntax checks, Python tests and delayed-image viewer tests; markdown-it-py parses document links/images before contained file-target checks; diff whitespace is checked.
controls.trigger: each integration checkpoint and configured CI event
controls.failure_response: Preserve failure output, fix the cause and rerun before claiming portable acceptance.
controls.limitations: Fake bridge tests do not execute CDDA. Loopback tests require bind permission; missing Node or dev tools and denied binds fail the lane. Markdown link/image targets are checked, excluding anchors, external availability and raw HTML links. Ruff selects E9/F63/F7/F82, not comprehensive formatting or typing.
controls.enforcement: Common command and opt-in local hook; main also requires the observed GitHub Actions controller check (app 15368) with strict freshness under active ruleset 25319489. Local hooks remain bypassable; dated hosted/probe evidence is in public-workflow acceptance.

last_exercise.outcome: Passed within recorded scope after preserved repairs; limitations retained.
last_exercise.scope: Native-v2 and gameplay/1 contracts, durable crash admission, boundary/frame/version gates and retention regressions; synthetic lane only.

maintenance_review.findings: 144-test implementation lane and focused 46-test evidence lane passed after fixture/conflict repairs. Later still-frame manifest regression extends this lane; final counts live in PR evidence.
maintenance_review.cost: One full local lane plus targeted regressions; count is not a quality metric.
maintenance_review.follow_up: Review on changed contracts, native failures, tool/refactor or next_review; #13 tracks upkeep. Full recovery and real gameplay evidence pipeline remain separate acceptance gates.

controls.name: Live authority and input guards
controls.scope: Single-controller dispatch, HTTP trust boundary and spectator input freshness.
controls.mechanism: Controller serializes dispatch, persists input admissions and revokes durable host tokens before retirement; native v2 checks boundary, matching frame and token at commit. Server validates origin/token/frame paths; viewer waits for matching decoded image and supported boundary.
controls.trigger: every relevant request, observation and image decode
controls.failure_response: Reject or freeze further dispatch; expose error and reconcile by observation before explicit resume.
controls.limitations: Tests exercise fake-bridge and browser fixtures. Native takeover and engine input behavior need C-NATIVE. Pause cannot cancel an already-running activity; no structured damage/trap or combat guarantee.
controls.enforcement: Implemented at runtime; regression execution is C-PORTABLE. Source references alone establish no behavioral pass.

last_exercise.outcome: Passed within recorded scope after preserved repairs; limitations retained.
last_exercise.scope: Live native input authority, menu/normal/activity/debug separation, stale world rejection and durable unknown outcome across service restart.

maintenance_review.findings: Live revoked-token and v1 packets rejected; timed-out real load retained through reconciliation/restart. Pause cannot undo a committed input or interrupt a native activity.
maintenance_review.cost: Local single-writer runtime and persistent admission files; unresolved entries require retained incident evidence.
maintenance_review.follow_up: Review on changed contracts, native failures, tool/refactor or next_review; #13 tracks upkeep. Full recovery and real gameplay evidence pipeline remain separate acceptance gates.

controls.failure_response: Retain failed/unknown probes, block the affected claim and repair or document the supported limit.

controls.name: Operator understanding review
controls.scope: Overview, navigation, control ownership, freshness, recovery limits and next decision.
controls.mechanism: Walk overview and immediate links for purpose, capabilities/limits, rationale, decisions and evidence; inspect changed visuals at ordinary window width, text equivalents and consequential failure/recovery paths against current contracts. Inspect UI flows when changed.
controls.trigger: user-facing behavior/guidance change and milestone review
controls.failure_response: Correct misleading flows or guidance and retain consequential limits before milestone acceptance.
controls.limitations: Human judgment; no automated usability score or user study is claimed. Document links alone do not demonstrate comprehension.
controls.enforcement: Required review under S-UX/S-DOCS/S-WORK; no automatic usability gate.

controls.name: Architectural dependency contracts
controls.scope: Declared controller and server dependency boundaries, including indirect imports through harness modules. Passive gameplay records and evidence must not import controller, HTTP, CLI or process/build tooling.
controls.mechanism: Import Linter uses the pyproject.toml forbidden contracts: controller cannot depend on server, CLI, declared network modules or build tooling; server cannot depend on CLI/tools; CLI may compose both.
controls.trigger: common command; architecture changes require rule review
controls.failure_response: Remove reversed dependency or review the boundary and checker together before accepting changed architecture.
controls.limitations: Static import graph with configured external roots. Dynamic imports, external-package internals, undeclared libraries and semantic C++ isolation remain review concerns; this is not comprehensive module layering.
controls.enforcement: Common command runs the real lint-imports executable and propagates failure; temporary source fixtures exercise allowed composition and direct/indirect forbidden imports.

last_exercise.outcome: Passed within recorded scope after preserved repairs; limitations retained.
last_exercise.scope: Three Import Linter contracts, adding passive gameplay and negative import fixtures.

maintenance_review.findings: Passive records/evidence cannot import controller/server/CLI or process/network/tooling modules; an initial missing test-fixture package was repaired.
maintenance_review.cost: Existing mature tool reused; no new dependency.
maintenance_review.follow_up: Review on changed contracts, native failures, tool/refactor or next_review; #13 tracks upkeep. Full recovery and real gameplay evidence pipeline remain separate acceptance gates.

controls.name: Design and independent change review
controls.scope: Consequential designs, implementation, tests, delegation and exceptions.
controls.mechanism: Lead owns design/integration and verifies returned evidence; at most two workers use separate project-local worktrees and named disjoint paths, with shared runtime serialized; fresh-context review assesses contracts, risk and maintainability before acceptance.
controls.trigger: significant change, new boundary/guarantee/dependency or integration checkpoint
controls.failure_response: Resolve material findings or record scoped owner/reason/revisit exception; after two unsuccessful worker repairs lead takes back the work.
controls.limitations: No code checker proves reasoning quality, typing completeness, decomposition or delegation compliance; independence depends on the actual review process.
controls.enforcement: Required by S-AGENT and the GitHub work/PR workflow; independent agent review is manually recorded, not an independent GitHub human approval. Hosted enforcement is recorded separately in acceptance.

last_exercise.outcome: Passed within recorded scope after preserved repairs; limitations retained.
last_exercise.scope: Two isolated implementation workers, separate native/evidence reviewers and clean-context final integration audit.

maintenance_review.findings: Review found crash identity loss, menu exclusions and noncurrent evidence rearming; repairs and regressions independently verified. Integration audit found no additional defect. Not human approval or exhaustive proof.

controls.name: Registry, evidence schema and map validation
controls.scope: Standard mappings, control lifecycle/maintenance, document stewardship, local references, curated manifest metadata and generated map.
controls.mechanism: Existing jsonschema validates records and YAML metadata parsed by python-frontmatter; project checks enforce current lifecycle relationships, safe references, active-only mappings, due dates, protocol source agreement and generated-map freshness. --as-of explicitly forecasts maintenance; the common command evaluates today.
controls.trigger: common command; regenerate map after registry change
controls.failure_response: Fix missing/unknown mappings, unsafe references or metadata; regenerate stale map with --write and inspect the result.
controls.limitations: Structure, recorded dates and local file existence are checked, not prose truth, artifact hashes outside diagram receipts, media availability, actual review/execution, owner performance or historical lifecycle authorization. Due checks run only when invoked; fragment targets are not validated.
controls.enforcement: Common command fails; negative tests exercise mapping/field/reference/drift failures. Normal mode never rewrites the map.

last_exercise.outcome: Passed, including genuine still-frame acceptance and malformed video rejection.
last_exercise.scope: Existing schema/path/provenance checks plus explicit video:null acceptance; 145-test common lane. No automatic verification of local media semantics.

maintenance_review.findings: Removed mandatory-video assumption for original still-frame evidence using existing JSON Schema; malformed video values and invalid intervals still reject. Generated control map and protocol-v2 agreement checked.
maintenance_review.cost: Small existing-schema extension and one regression; no new validator.
maintenance_review.follow_up: Review evidence format changes and control drift under #13; schema validity never proves content truth.

controls.name: Protocol v2 source agreement
controls.scope: Native emitter/validator, controller send/response/stored-request validators, server advertisement, CLI discovery validator, viewer guard and protocol document version.
controls.mechanism: Recognize the current two C++ literal forms, Python AST dictionary/comparison literals, JavaScript viewer guard and document version; require each of the nine forms to represent v2 exactly once.
controls.trigger: common command; any protocol representation change requires checker review
controls.failure_response: Resolve version drift; for a refactor/version change review and update checker plus contract, then run required native acceptance.
controls.limitations: Narrow source drift detector, not a robust C++ parser or protocol conformance proof. Refactored representations fail for review; matching literals cannot prove runtime behavior.
controls.enforcement: Common command fails on version drift or unrecognized source form; each representation has a negative fixture.

last_exercise.outcome: Passed within recorded scope after preserved repairs; limitations retained.
last_exercise.scope: Nine recognized native-v2 source forms, including stored-request and viewer guards, with drift rejection fixtures; broader absence of compatibility paths is reviewed.

maintenance_review.findings: All source forms agree on v2; actual native v1 rejection and revoked-token rejection observed. Source literals alone still cannot prove conformance. Coordinated migration adds stored-request/viewer forms; narrow checks are not a whole-code compatibility proof.
maintenance_review.cost: Narrow recognizer updated with version/CLI integration and negative fixtures.

controls.name: Isolated pinned setup
controls.scope: Explicit download/extract/build/install stages and checkout-owned temporary workspaces.
controls.mechanism: Setup verifies checksums, extraction paths and build ownership; preserves existing app/environment, records local manifests and never launches the game automatically.
controls.trigger: each requested setup stage and dependency/compiler change
controls.failure_response: Stop failed stage, preserve diagnostics and retry only after identifying the corrupt input or owned workspace.
controls.limitations: Portable fixtures do not perform fresh downloads, native compilation/signing or install. Existing-host recipe is historical; broader hosts remain unverified.
controls.enforcement: Implemented stage guards plus portable setup regressions; native reproducibility requires C-NATIVE and manual provenance review.

controls.name: Exact candidate and evidence review
controls.scope: Checkpoint/release scope, source provenance and validation lanes.
controls.mechanism: Inspect staged diff and candidate identity, run common checks against exact candidate, review pins/open exceptions and require relevant native probes for affected claims.
controls.failure_response: Hold the affected acceptance/release claim until failed or unexecuted required lanes are resolved or scope is explicitly reduced.
controls.limitations: Working-tree hooks do not prove a partially staged candidate. Hosted source/check enforcement does not establish native gameplay, semantic review or release authority. No tag or release automation is installed; administrators can later change rules.
controls.enforcement: Main requires a PR, the Actions-bound controller check and resolved conversations; no force-push/deletion or configured bypass. Lead still owns native/release acceptance. Zero required human approvals is an explicit single-account limit; agent review is not human approval.

controls.name: Drift, recovery and retention review
controls.scope: Active guidance, dependency/research freshness, failure evidence and project-owned cleanup.
controls.mechanism: Review active guidance/visuals, controls and dependencies on changed behavior/failure/release/resumption and within recorded periodic dates. Record findings, effectiveness, cost and follow-up in registry with dated evidence; promote repeated defects into tests or revise/retire controls. C-GOVERNANCE detects elapsed due dates when invoked.
controls.trigger: behavior/control failure, release, resumed work or active-development review interval
controls.failure_response: Record specific owner and next action, repair inaccurate guidance and preserve unresolved failures; never delete saves as routine cleanup.
controls.limitations: Review quality and event-trigger detection remain manual. No background scheduler, automatic drift measurement or deletion job; passing date checks proves only that recorded dates are not overdue, not that review occurred.
controls.enforcement: Manual requirements under S-OPS/S-AGENT/S-DOCS/S-EVIDENCE, with registry fields, references and overdue dates enforced by C-GOVERNANCE in the common lane.

controls.name: Rendered visual documentation
controls.scope: Mermaid sources and generated SVGs in docs/diagrams.
controls.mechanism: Pinned local Mermaid CLI renders every source in a headless project-local browser. Hash receipt covers sources, config, wrapper, package lock and tracked SVGs; title/description and root SVG ID are required. Explicit --write regenerates; normal checks leave tracked files unchanged.
controls.trigger: common command; source, renderer configuration or dependency changes require rendered review
controls.failure_response: Fix syntax or missing setup; regenerate stale output and inspect the rendered result. Never call a denied browser launch a passed check. Resolve semantic/readability findings through C-USABILITY/C-REVIEW.
controls.limitations: Receipt freshness is not cross-host byte equality or proof against deliberate falsification. Rendering and SVG metadata do not prove meaning, accessibility for every reader or readable layout. Human rendered inspection is required. Ubuntu 24.04 CI was exercised with a scoped runner Chrome sandbox profile; other Linux hosts remain unverified.
controls.enforcement: Common command fails on renderer errors, missing title/description/ID or changed input/output receipts; negative fixtures include a real parse failure. No global installation or automatic fetch.
controls.rationale: Required to keep user-facing visual explanations reviewable and synchronized.

last_exercise.scope: Updated action sequence rendered and inspected at ordinary width, independently compared with authority contract.
